title: [Master] - Slice 611452: [AT][IC][RegF] Enable Danish SAF-T to be used in Austria and Iceland
summary: Lets the Danish SAF-T functionality be used in Austria and Iceland. The SAFTModificationDK app and its tests move under the W1 apps folder, the AT, IS and DK build project settings are updated, and small changes are made across the SAF-T app objects and tests.
key_points: SAFTModificationDK app and tests relocated to src/Apps/W1/SAFTModificationDK
Austria and Iceland build projects configured to include SAF-T; Denmark project settings adjusted
Small edits in SAF-T codeunits, query, table extensions and wizard page
SAF-T app and test app.json files updated
